name: ASTERIAL
releaseNotes: Complete ASTERIAL v1.6.0 product redesign: refined #090A0D / #101217 / #171A21 / #7778F6 token system, complete Light & System themes, responsive 4-zone desktop workspace, and dedicated 5-tab mobile architecture.

Guided first-launch Welcome (/welcome), Account Creation & Recovery (/signup, /login, /forgot-password), and 3-step Onboarding (/onboarding) with live username availability, avatar setup, and initial preferences.

WhatsApp + Discord messaging experience: sender/time-grouped message clusters, server-enforced group role badges, real Message Info receipt inspector, Enter-to-Send & Link Preview preferences, media auto-load controls, Shared Media drawer, and voice notes.

Dedicated multi-route Settings Center (/app/settings/*) covering Overview, Profile, Appearance, Chat, Notifications, Privacy (with server-enforced group invite & search discoverability policies), Security, real Storage & Media telemetry, and About.
